document.abstract: The Digital Video Broadcasting (DVB) project’s suite of specifications continues to grow and evolve to address the diverse market needs of the many territories where they are used. DVB’s overarching objective remains to provide standards-based solutions that will allow the industry to adapt to future market challenges and capitalize on new technologies and opportunities offered by broadband and mobile networks.

authors.bio: Emily Dubs assumed her current position as the head of technology in January 2020, coming to DVB with 20 years of experience in the digital television industry. Previously, she worked with Thomson Video Networks (now Harmonic), France, TeamCast (now ENENSYS), France, and SmarDTV/Neotion, France, in roles covering both traditional broadcast technologies and those emerging from the broadband world.
